question.text: What will the EIA report as the week-over-week change in U.S. commercial crude oil inventories (excluding SPR) for the week ending 6 November 2026?
question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves on the "Week-on-week change for United States" figure for commercial crude oil stocks (excluding the Strategic Petroleum Reserve) reported in the EIA's Weekly Petroleum Status Report for the week ending 6 November 2026, scheduled for publication at 12:00 p.m. ET (17:00 UTC) on 12 November 2026 at https://www.eia.gov/petroleum/supply/weekly/. The answer is that figure in thousand barrels, with a draw reported as a negative number: for example, the −1,892 thousand barrels reported for the week ending 23 October 2026 resolves as −1892. If EIA's release for that week is delayed, the question resolves once the figure is published. Should the WPSR page no longer display that week, the figure may be taken as the week-ending stock level for 6 November 2026 minus that for 30 October 2026 from EIA's weekly ending-stocks series (https://www.eia.gov/dnav/pet/hist/LeafHandler.ashx?n=PET&s=WCESTUS1&f=W).
question.fine_print: The resolving figure is the one published in the 12 November 2026 release; later revisions to either week's stock level do not change the resolution.

Status: I've pulled the EIA stock series and checked SPR exchange news. Now writing up the findings.

## 1. Resolution source

- The figure that decides the question will be published on 2026-11-12 at 17:00 UTC. A downloadable file is also available: [WCESTUS1w.xls](https://www.eia.gov/dnav/pet/hist_xls/WCESTUS1w.xls)

## 2. Current status

## 3. Recent news (newest first)

Other figures: Cushing -624k; runs -123k b/d; utilisation 92.8%; gasoline +3.9M; distillates -1.5M; net imports -796k b/d. The API had shown -2.03M, against an expected +0.8M. [BOE Report/Reuters](https://boereport.com/2026/10/28/us-crude-stocks-and-distillate-inventories-fall-gasoline-stocks-rise-the-eia-says/amp/), [Kitco](https://kitco.com/news/off-the-wire/2026-10-28/us-crude-and-distillate-inventories-fall-gasoline-stocks-rise-eia-says)
- 2026-10-26: DOE offered an exchange of up to 400k bbl from West Hackberry for immediate delivery (a local refinery bottleneck). This comes from search summaries; I did not verify it against a primary source.
- Around 2026-10-13: Argus, citing sources, reported that 20-25M bbl from the 40M bbl SPR sour-crude exchange offered on 9/29 was awarded to Exxon, Macquarie, Centalion, ATMI, Trafigura and Energy Transfer, with **delivery in November and December**. Those barrels move from the SPR into commercial stocks or exports, which could push the figure up by about 1-3M bbl/week if deliveries are spread evenly. I could not open the article to confirm. [Argus](https://www.argusmedia.com/de/news-and-insights/latest-market-news/2890203-us-awards-up-to-25mn-bl-spr-crude-sources)
- Analysts have repeatedly missed: the Reuters poll expected a build and the EIA reported draws in recent weeks. The week ending 10/16 drew about 3M, against roughly -1.3M expected.

## 4. Base rates
I calculated these weekly changes from the EIA series:
- **2026, 43 weeks:** 19 builds and 24 draws (about 44% builds). The typical absolute change is about 3-6M. Extremes were +17,423 (8/7) and -9,014 (2/13).
- **Last 12 weeks:** +17,423, +4,405, +95, -4,450, -391, -640, +2,969, +922, -3,186, -8,557, -3,060, -1,892. The standard deviation is about 6.5M with the 8/7 outlier and about 3.8M without it.
- **Trend:** October had four straight draws (-16.7M in total). May and June had nine straight draws.
- **Same weeks in 2025:** week ending 10/31/2025 was +5,202 and 11/7/2025 was +6,413. Early November usually brings builds as refineries go into autumn maintenance and runs vary, though utilisation is still high at 92.8%.
- In 2026 the level ranged from 404.5M (7/24) to 465.7M (4/17).

## 5. Other forecasts
- Kalshi, week ending 10/30 level: "Above 410M" 0.53, "Above 411M" 0.48, "Above 412M" 0.41, "Above 409M" 0.67, "Above 406M" 0.84. The implied median is about 410.8M, roughly flat to +0.2M against 410.6M. This is the prior week, not the question's week.
- Kalshi, November crude exports: above 4.5M b/d 0.46; above 4.0M 0.81.
- Kalshi, end-November gasoline stocks: below 210M 0.50.
- Polymarket SPR markets (whether the SPR falls to 280M or below by 10/30) are priced at about 2-3%.
- I found no market or analyst consensus for the week ending 11/6. The Reuters poll usually comes out around 11/9-11/10.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- 2026-11-03 (Tue): API estimate for the week ending 10/30.
- 2026-11-04 (Wed): EIA WPSR for the week ending 10/30. This sets the base level and shows the latest export, import and run trends.
- 2026-11-05 onward: whether the November SPR exchange deliveries actually start (watch the weekly SPR change). There are also further US-Iran peace-talk headlines, which could swing prices and export economics, and OPEC+ follow-up.
- 2026-11-10 (Tue): API estimate for the week ending 11/6.
- 2026-11-11: Veterans Day, so the EIA release moves to 2026-11-12 at 12:00 ET.
- Other things to watch: Gulf Coast weather or fog affecting tanker movements, and refinery maintenance and restarts.

# EIA crude inventory change, week ending 6 Nov 2026: research brief

Nothing settles this question yet. The 6 Nov figure comes out on 12 Nov, and even the 30 Oct week is not published until 4 Nov. The main things that could move it are Gulf Coast SPR exchange deliveries due in November and December, and possible changes in US crude exports as prices fall.

## 1. Resolution source
- 2026-10-28 release: EIA weekly commercial crude stocks excluding SPR (WCESTUS1), in thousand barrels: 10/02 424,134; 10/09 415,577; 10/16 412,517; 10/23 410,625. The page says the next release is 11/4/2026. [EIA series](https://www.eia.gov/dnav/pet/hist/LeafHandler.ashx?n=PET&s=WCESTUS1&f=W)
- The raw data file is linked from that page: https://www.eia.gov/dnav/pet/hist_xls/WCESTUS1w.xls
- 2026-10-28: the draw for the week ending 23 Oct was -1,892. The Reuters poll had expected a 15,000 bbl build. Cushing fell 624k bbl, utilisation was 92.8% and net imports fell 796k b/d. [BOE Report/Reuters](https://boereport.com/2026/10/28/us-crude-stocks-and-distillate-inventories-fall-gasoline-stocks-rise-the-eia-says/amp/)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing has been published for the week ending 6 Nov. The week ending 30 Oct is due on 2026-11-04.
- Kalshi's market on the 30 Oct stock level centres near 410 to 411M bbl: "Above 410M" is at 0.53 and "Above 411M" at 0.48. That implies a change close to flat for that week.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-11-02: TASS, citing DOE data, says the SPR fell to 282.2M bbl in the week ending 30 Oct, down about 0.4M bbl and the lowest since 1982. That figure seems to come before the EIA release, so treat it with caution. [TASS](https://tass.com/economy/2212095)
- 2026-11-02: Oil fell about 6% after Iran-Qatar talks aimed at ending the eight-month US-Iran war. [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/news/us-stock-index-futures-jump-as-oil-falls-about-6-ce785fd9d989f520)
- 2026-11-01: OPEC+ (the seven members who met) kept December output unchanged. [PR Newswire](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/oil-enters-november-with-opec-holding-steady-and-five-producers-set-to-report-302926283.html)
- 2026-10-29: DOE's news sidebar lists an award of more than 40M bbl in SPR exchange contracts, completing the 172M bbl release commitment. I could not read the award page itself to confirm its details. [DOE](https://www.energy.gov/articles/united-states-energy-department-continues-execution-strategic-reserve-release-commitments)
- 2026-09-29: DOE's request for proposals offered up to 40M bbl from Big Hill and Bryan Mound, with deliveries scheduled for November and December 2026. [DOE](https://www.energy.gov/articles/united-states-energy-department-continues-execution-strategic-reserve-release-commitments)
  - If about 40M bbl is delivered over roughly 8 to 9 weeks, that is on the order of 4 to 5M bbl a week moving from the SPR into commercial channels. This is my own arithmetic, not a DOE schedule. Some of it may be exported rather than stored.
  - The Strait of Hormuz has been closed since March 2026, and Asian importers are building stockpiles, which supports demand for US exports. [Intellinews](https://www.intellinews.com/indonesia-india-and-pakistan-race-to-stockpile-oil-after-hormuz-shock-mckinsey-480932/)

## 4. Base rates
Week-on-week changes in 2026, in million bbl, calculated from the EIA series:
- **July:** +3.00, -1.69, +2.01, -7.17, +2.48
- **August:** +17.42 (week ending 7 Aug), +4.41, +0.10, -4.45
- **September:** -0.39, -0.64, +2.97, +0.92
- **October:** -3.19, -8.56, -3.06, -1.89

What the numbers show:
- The last 16 weeks have a median of about +0.0 and a mean of about +0.1. The standard deviation is about 6M including the +17.4 outlier, and about 4M without it.
- About 50% of weeks were builds.
- Stocks have fallen four weeks in a row. Since late March, the overall trend has been sharply downward because of SPR exchanges plus strong exports.

Same weeks in 2025:
- Week ending 31 Oct 2025: +5.20
- Week ending 7 Nov 2025: +6.41
- Week ending 14 Nov 2025: -3.43

Seasonality: early November is often a build period, because refineries come back from autumn maintenance with a lag while imports recover.

## 5. Other forecasts
- Kalshi, stocks for the week ending 30 Oct: Above 406M 0.84; 408M 0.73; 410M 0.53; 411M 0.48; 412M 0.41; 413M 0.32; 415M 0.24. This covers the prior week, not the target week.
- Kalshi, November crude exports: Above 4.0M b/d 0.81; above 4.5M 0.46; above 5.0M 0.17.
- Kalshi, gasoline stocks at end of November: roughly even odds of falling below 200 to 210M bbl.
- I found no Reuters poll or market for the week ending 6 Nov. The Reuters poll usually appears around 10 to 11 Nov. Searches for analyst expectations for the week ending 30 Oct also turned up nothing. [search results, e.g. Investinglive preview](https://investinglive.com/education/us-oil-inventory-preview-five-terms-to-know-before-wednesday-s-eia-data/)

- 2026-11-10 (Tuesday evening): API estimate for the week ending 6 Nov. It is directionally useful but often differs from EIA by more than 1M bbl.
- 2026-11-12, 12:00 ET: the EIA release that resolves the question, delayed by Veterans Day.
